title: manuscript-guard harvest.yaml: outputs a script writes, taken in as results
description: Each entry names an output file an analysis script writes without the emitter (a .csv, .tsv or .json), the script, and the data it read. `manuscript-guard harvest` reads the output and writes results/<key>.json from it; it never runs anything, so the link from the script to the output is declared, and G1 says so (`harvest-declared`) until `verify` reproduces it or a site's receipt covers it.

path.description: A path from the project's root, with forward slashes; never absolute and never leaving the project.

key.description: The results file is results/<key>.json, its table table.<key>, and each value <key>.<row>.<column>.

output.description: The file the script writes: comma- or tab-separated with a header row, or JSON (an object of scalars, or an array of records with `row_key`).

script.description: The script declared to write the output. Its digest now is recorded; G1 fails `script-newer` once it changes.

inputs.description: The data the script read, as the emitter records them, so that G1 holds them as it holds an emitted fragment's.

row_key.description: The column whose cells name the rows. Without it a table's rows are numbered from 1; an array of JSON records needs it.

columns.description: The columns taken in, by their headers, in this order; all of them where absent. The row key's column is always taken, first.

digits.description: Decimal places a number is shown to: one for every column, or by column header. Without it each display is the output's own text.

receipt.description: The site that holds the data: its `verify --receipt <site>` ran the script there and wrote receipts/<site>.receipt.json, which covers this output.
